pack.spice:
* TinyCAD selection of circsim models

.subckt opamp_core inp inn out vcc vee
+ params: aol=100k gbw=1e6 slew=0.5e6 vos=0 rout=75 dsat=0 vsathi=1.5 vsatlo=0.0 iq=0.5m
* input sense (high-Z): e = (inp - inn) + offset
bin e 0 v = v(inp,inn) + vos
* dominant-pole network. Rp chosen for DC gain = aol; Cp for pole at gbw/aol.
* A transconductance gm=1 drives Rp||Cp, so V(vpole) = gm*V(e)*Rp at DC and the
* pole sits at fp = 1/(2*pi*Rp*Cp). Set Rp=aol (gm=1 -> DC gain=aol) and
* Cp = 1/(2*pi*Rp*fp) with fp = gbw/aol -> unity-gain crossing at gbw.
.param rp = {aol}
.param cp = {1/(6.283185307*rp*(gbw/aol))}
* slew-rate current limit: gm*v(e) for small signals, +/- imax at most.
.param imax = {slew*cp}
* gate width (V) and stiff-clamp conductance (A/V, 5 mV overshoot at imax).
.param wg = 0.005
.param kc = {imax/0.005}
* output limits, live from the rail pins and shifted by dsat*Iout (item 4).
blo clo 0 v = v(vee) + vsatlo + dsat*i(vsns)
bhi chi 0 v = v(vcc) - vsathi + dsat*i(vsns)
bmid vmid 0 v = 0.5*(v(clo) + v(chi))
* smooth rails-present measure: 0 at 0 V across the rails, 1 above about 2 V.
bpr pr 0 v = 0.5*(1 + tanh((v(vcc) - v(vee) - 1)/0.25))
* drive current: imax*tanh(e/imax) (sign and saturation), times one gate per
* limit: the upper gate closes the positive drive as vpole reaches chi, the lower
* gate closes the negative drive as vpole reaches clo. Each gate is offset by
* 3.6*wg so the drive has just fallen to the pole leak current when vpole reaches
* the limit, which parks vpole at the limit itself. The expression is kept in one
* piece on purpose: split into intermediate nodes, the zero starting value of
* those nodes would hide the gm path from the first Newton pass.
bg 0 vpole i = imax*tanh(v(e)/imax)*( 0.5*(1 + tanh(v(e)/imax))*0.5*(1 - tanh((v(vpole) - v(chi))/wg + 3.6))
+ + 0.5*(1 - tanh(v(e)/imax))*0.5*(1 + tanh((v(vpole) - v(clo))/wg - 3.6)) )
rp vpole vmid {rp}
cp vpole 0 {cp}
* stiff clamp, 30 mV beyond each limit, active only with the rails present. The
* upper knee is the high limit floored at the low limit (soft max), so a
* collapsed or unpowered supply parks the pole node at the low limit instead of
* the midpoint of an inverted window. The floor is written inline: as a node it
* would be a nonlinear function of the rails whose value after the first Newton
* pass is wrong, while chi and clo, being linear in the rails, are exact.
bclp vpole 0 i = v(pr)*kc*( 0.5*((v(vpole)-v(clo)-0.5*((v(chi)-v(clo)) + sqrt((v(chi)-v(clo))*(v(chi)-v(clo)) + 0.01))-0.03) + sqrt((v(vpole)-v(clo)-0.5*((v(chi)-v(clo)) + sqrt((v(chi)-v(clo))*(v(chi)-v(clo)) + 0.01))-0.03)*(v(vpole)-v(clo)-0.5*((v(chi)-v(clo)) + sqrt((v(chi)-v(clo))*(v(chi)-v(clo)) + 0.01))-0.03) + 1e-6))
+ - 0.5*((v(clo)-0.03-v(vpole)) + sqrt((v(clo)-0.03-v(vpole))*(v(clo)-0.03-v(vpole)) + 1e-6)) )
* output buffer: follow vpole, referenced to the vee pin, then drive the pin
* through rout and a 0 V output-current sense source.
bout obuf vee v = v(vpole) - v(vee)
rout obuf osns {rout}
vsns osns out 0
* supply-pin currents: sourced output current moves vcc -> vee (sunk output
* current already leaves through vee via the vee-referenced Bout); quiescent
* current is constant. The sqrt form is the smooth positive part of i(vsns).
* Both are scaled by the rails-present measure pr, so a rail that is floating
* or not yet powered carries no draw (a current source alone on a floating rail
* would push it to an absurd voltage) and the model draws exactly iq once
* powered (pr is 1 above about 2 V).
bsrc vcc vee i = v(pr)*0.5*( i(vsns) + sqrt(i(vsns)*i(vsns) + 1e-12) )
biq vcc vee i = iq*v(pr)
.ends opamp_core

.subckt LM741 inp inn out vcc vee
xa inp inn out vcc vee opamp_core
+ params: aol=200k gbw=1e6 slew=0.5e6 vos=1e-3 rout=75 vsathi=1 vsatlo=1 iq=1.7m
.ends LM741

.subckt LM393 inp inn out vcc vee
+ params: iq=0.4m
* high-gain decision node 'dec' relative to vee (single supply friendly)
xc inp inn dec vcc vee opamp_core
+ params: aol=200k gbw=0.8e6 slew=10e6 vos=1e-3 rout=50 vsathi=0.3 vsatlo=0.2 iq={iq}
* open-collector pulldown: when dec is HIGH (>mid) the output transistor is OFF
* (high-Z); when dec is LOW the transistor pulls 'out' toward vee through Ron.
* Model as a voltage-controlled resistance from out to vee. The sunk current
* leaves through the vee pin, so the supply side needs no extra source.
* gatev ~ 1 when output should be LOW (dec low), ~0 when output high-Z.
bsw out vee i = (v(dec) < ((v(vcc)+v(vee))/2)) ?
+ ((v(out)-v(vee))/40) : ((v(out)-v(vee))/1e9)
.ends LM393

.subckt LM339_QUAD in1p in1n out1 in2p in2n out2 in3p in3n out3 in4p in4n out4 vcc vee
x1 in1p in1n out1 vcc vee LM393 params: iq=0.2m
x2 in2p in2n out2 vcc vee LM393 params: iq=0.2m
x3 in3p in3n out3 vcc vee LM393 params: iq=0.2m
x4 in4p in4n out4 vcc vee LM393 params: iq=0.2m
.ends LM339_QUAD

.subckt NE5532 inap inan outa inbp inbn outb vcc vee
xa inap inan outa vcc vee opamp_core
+ params: aol=100k gbw=10e6 slew=9e6 vos=0.5e-3 rout=50 vsathi=2 vsatlo=2 iq=4m
xb inbp inbn outb vcc vee opamp_core

.subckt NE555 gnd trig out reset ctrl thres disch vcc
*
* ---- internal 5k / 5k / 5k resistor divider ----
* VCC --[5k]-- ctrl(=2/3 Vcc) --[5k]-- ntrig(=1/3 Vcc) --[5k]-- GND
* The CTRL pin is brought out at the 2/3 node (so an external cap/voltage on
* CTRL shifts the upper threshold, per the datasheet).
rdiv_a vcc ctrl 5k
rdiv_b ctrl n13 5k
rdiv_c n13 gnd 5k
*
* ---- supply current ----
* The datasheet supply current (about 3 mA at 5 V, about 10 mA at 15 V, output
* low, no load) is nearly resistive. This shunt, together with the 15k divider
* above, draws about 3.1 mA at 5 V and 9.3 mA at 15 V.
rq vcc gnd 1.8k
*
* Start-up ramps used below, written out in each expression on purpose (an
* intermediate node would start at 0 V and hide the ramp from the first Newton
* pass):
*   sf = (time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0) is 1 at time 0 and 0 from 1 us on;
*   mr = (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)     is 0 at time 0 and 1 from 1 us on.
*
* ---- upper (threshold) comparator ----
* output -> 1 when THRES > CTRL (2/3 Vcc). Drives the latch RESET input.
* Smooth step 2 mV wide (1 V wide at time 0).
bcomphi chi gnd v = 0.5*(1 + tanh(v(thres,ctrl)/(0.002 + 1.0*(time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0))))
*
* ---- lower (trigger) comparator ----
* output -> 1 when TRIG < 1/3 Vcc (node n13). Drives the latch SET input.
bcomplo clo gnd v = 0.5*(1 + tanh(v(n13,trig)/(0.002 + 1.0*(time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0))))
*
* ---- active-low RESET pin gate (datasheet threshold about 1 V) ----
* rok -> 1 when the pin is high (latch allowed to run), -> 0 when pulled low.
brok rok gnd v = 0.5*(1 + tanh((v(reset,gnd) - 1)/0.05))
*
* ---- RS latch with active-low RESET pin override ----
* State node 'q' is algebraic: the voltage source below forces
*   q = run * ( clo + (1-clo)*mr*hold(q) ),   run = (1-chi)*rok,
*   hold(q) = 1 when q > 0.5, else 0.
* run is 0 whenever the upper comparator or the RESET pin resets the latch
* (RESET is dominant, per the datasheet) and clo = 1 sets it. The self-reference
* through hold(q) is the latch memory, with two branches:
*   set branch    q = run      (hold = 1), valid while run > 0.5
*   reset branch  q = run*clo  (hold = 0), valid while run*clo < 0.5
* so the latch resets when the upper comparator passes its midpoint (THRES =
* CTRL) or RESET falls through 1 V, and sets when the lower comparator passes
* its midpoint (TRIG = Vcc/3). The memory term is off at time 0 (mr = 0), so the
* operating point is the smooth function q = run*clo: output low and discharge
* on whenever neither comparator is active, with no memory to choose between two
* states. There is deliberately no capacitor or lag on q (see "Solver step"
* above): the real part's propagation delay (about 100 ns) is far below the
* step circsim normally takes.
bq q gnd v = v(rok,gnd)*(1 - v(chi,gnd))*( v(clo,gnd) + (1 - v(clo,gnd))*(time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0) )
* Read the latch state for the output. From 1 us on this is the same hard
* decision as the memory, so the output changes only when q jumps between
* branches. A readout that moved along a branch (q runs from 1 down to 0.5 on
* the set branch as THRES approaches CTRL) would let the discharge switch and
* THRES settle into an analog equilibrium at the threshold. At time 0 it is a
* smooth step of slope 8 per volt.
bqd qd gnd v = (time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0)*0.5*(1 + tanh(8*(v(q,gnd) - 0.5))) + (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0)
*
* ---- output buffer (pin 3) ----
* OUT is HIGH (Vcc - 0.5) when the latch is SET, LOW (0.1 V) when reset,
* through a small output resistance; RESET low forces the output to 0 V. The
* buffer is referenced to the gnd pin, so current the load pushes into OUT
* leaves through gnd on its own. A 0 V sense source in series with the output
* resistance measures the output current, and a controlled source moves the
* SOURCED current from vcc to gnd so the supply pin carries the load (faded
* out below about 2 V so a floating rail carries nothing).
bout obuf gnd v = v(rok,gnd)*( 0.1 + (v(vcc,gnd) - 0.6)*v(qd,gnd) )
rout obuf osns 10
vsns osns out 0
bsrc vcc gnd i = 0.5*(1 + tanh((v(vcc,gnd) - 1)/0.25))*0.5*( i(vsns) + sqrt(i(vsns)*i(vsns) + 1e-12) )
*
* ---- discharge transistor (pin 7, open collector to GND) ----
* The discharge transistor is ON (DISCH pulled to GND through 15 ohm) when the
* output is LOW (latch reset) and OFF (1 Gohm) when the output is HIGH. RESET
* low forces it ON. Modeled as a voltage-controlled conductance from DISCH to
* GND; the current it sinks leaves through the gnd pin. The state readout inside
* it is the same as qd from 1 us on, and softer than qd at time 0 (3 per volt),
* because the loop through THRES is what the operating point has to solve.
bdisch disch gnd i = v(disch,gnd)*( (1 - ((time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0)*0.5*(1 + tanh(3*(v(q,gnd) - 0.5))) + (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0))*v(rok,gnd))/15 + (((time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0)*0.5*(1 + tanh(3*(v(q,gnd) - 0.5))) + (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0))*v(rok,gnd))/1e9 )
.ends NE555

.subckt reg_lin vin gnd vout
+ params: vreg=5 drop=2 dropl=1.5 irated=1 ilim=1.2 rout=0.05 iq=5m
* Load position: 0 at 0.1*irated, 1 at irated, from the pass current sensed by
* vsense below; smooth-clamped to [0,1] (0.02 wide) to give the load fraction.
blf lf gnd v = (i(vsense)/irated - 0.1)/0.9
bfrc frc gnd v = 0.5*( 1 + sqrt( v(lf,gnd)*v(lf,gnd) + 4e-4 ) - sqrt( (v(lf,gnd)-1)*(v(lf,gnd)-1) + 4e-4 ) )
* Load-dependent dropout voltage and the headroom-limited target.
bdrp dp gnd v = dropl + (drop - dropl)*v(frc,gnd)
btgt tgt gnd v = v(vin,gnd) - v(dp,gnd)
* Regulated target = smooth min(vreg, vin-dropout), smooth-floored at 0 (both
* smoothing widths 10 mV).
bmn mn gnd v = 0.5*( v(tgt,gnd) + vreg - sqrt( (v(tgt,gnd)-vreg)*(v(tgt,gnd)-vreg) + 1e-4 ) )
breg reg gnd v = 0.5*( v(mn,gnd) + sqrt( v(mn,gnd)*v(mn,gnd) + 1e-4 ) )
* output resistance for load regulation, then a 0 V ammeter to sense Iout.
rpass reg rsen {rout}
vsense rsen vout 0
* Current-limit foldback: once the sensed pass current exceeds ilim, sink the
* excess back to gnd so the net delivered current is held at the limit. The
* excess is a smooth positive part of (i(vsense) - ilim), 2 mA*ilim wide;
* i(vsense) is the current flowing out of the regulator into the load.
bexc exc gnd v = 0.5*( (i(vsense) - ilim) + sqrt( (i(vsense) - ilim)*(i(vsense) - ilim) + 4e-6*ilim*ilim ) )
bilim vout gnd i = v(exc,gnd)
* Input current: the current delivered through the output pin plus the
* quiescent ground current, drawn from the vin pin and returned to gnd. The
* quiescent part fades out below about 2 V so an unpowered input draws nothing.
biq vin gnd i = i(vsense) - v(exc,gnd) + iq*0.5*(1 + tanh((v(vin,gnd) - 1)/0.25))
.ends reg_lin

.subckt reg_lin_ref vin ref vout
+ params: vreg=5 drop=2 dropl=1.5 irated=1 ilim=1.2 rout=0.05 iq=5m
* Load position: 0 at 0.1*irated, 1 at irated, from the pass current sensed by
* vsense below; smooth-clamped to [0,1] (0.02 wide) to give the load fraction.
blf lf ref v = (i(vsense)/irated - 0.1)/0.9
bfrc frc ref v = 0.5*( 1 + sqrt( v(lf,ref)*v(lf,ref) + 4e-4 ) - sqrt( (v(lf,ref)-1)*(v(lf,ref)-1) + 4e-4 ) )
* Load-dependent dropout voltage and the headroom-limited target.
bdrp dp ref v = dropl + (drop - dropl)*v(frc,ref)
btgt tgt ref v = v(vin,ref) - v(dp,ref)
* Regulated target = smooth min(vreg, vin-dropout), smooth-floored at 0 (both
* smoothing widths 10 mV).
bmn mn ref v = 0.5*( v(tgt,ref) + vreg - sqrt( (v(tgt,ref)-vreg)*(v(tgt,ref)-vreg) + 1e-4 ) )
breg reg ref v = 0.5*( v(mn,ref) + sqrt( v(mn,ref)*v(mn,ref) + 1e-4 ) )
* output resistance for load regulation, then a 0 V ammeter to sense Iout.
rpass reg rsen {rout}
vsense rsen vout 0
* Current-limit foldback: once the sensed pass current exceeds ilim, sink the
* excess back to ref so the net delivered current is held at the limit. The
* excess is a smooth positive part of (i(vsense) - ilim), 2 mA*ilim wide;
* i(vsense) is the current flowing out of the regulator into the load.
bexc exc ref v = 0.5*( (i(vsense) - ilim) + sqrt( (i(vsense) - ilim)*(i(vsense) - ilim) + 4e-6*ilim*ilim ) )
bilim vout ref i = v(exc,ref)
* Input current: the current delivered through the output pin plus the
* quiescent ground current, drawn from the vin pin and returned to ref. The
* quiescent part fades out below about 2 V so an unpowered input draws nothing.
biq vin ref i = i(vsense) - v(exc,ref) + iq*0.5*(1 + tanh((v(vin,ref) - 1)/0.25))
.ends reg_lin_ref

.subckt 7805 vin gnd vout
xr vin gnd vout reg_lin params: vreg=5.0 drop=2.0 dropl=1.5 irated=1.0 ilim=1.2 rout=0.02 iq=5m
.ends 7805

.subckt TL431 k a ref
* high-gain error stage -> shunt element: sink from cathode to anode above Vref.
bshunt k a i = ( v(ref,a) > 2.495 ) ? ( (v(ref,a)-2.495)*10 + 1u ) : 1u
* reference-pin input bias current (~2uA into the ref pin)
bref ref a i = 2u
.ends TL431

.subckt LM317 vin adj vout
xr vin adj vout reg_lin_ref params: vreg=1.25 drop=2.0 dropl=1.5 irated=1.5 ilim=2.2 rout=0.01 iq=50u
.ends LM317

* Model as a voltage-controlled resistance from out to vee. The sunk current
* leaves through the vee pin, so the supply side needs no extra source.

models.description: Behavioural 555 timer with trigger, threshold, reset and discharge terminals.
models.definition:
.subckt NE555 gnd trig out reset ctrl thres disch vcc
*
* ---- internal 5k / 5k / 5k resistor divider ----
* VCC --[5k]-- ctrl(=2/3 Vcc) --[5k]-- ntrig(=1/3 Vcc) --[5k]-- GND
* The CTRL pin is brought out at the 2/3 node (so an external cap/voltage on
* CTRL shifts the upper threshold, per the datasheet).
rdiv_a vcc ctrl 5k
rdiv_b ctrl n13 5k
rdiv_c n13 gnd 5k
*
* ---- supply current ----
* The datasheet supply current (about 3 mA at 5 V, about 10 mA at 15 V, output
* low, no load) is nearly resistive. This shunt, together with the 15k divider
* above, draws about 3.1 mA at 5 V and 9.3 mA at 15 V.
rq vcc gnd 1.8k
*
* Start-up ramps used below, written out in each expression on purpose (an
* intermediate node would start at 0 V and hide the ramp from the first Newton
* pass):
*   sf = (time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0) is 1 at time 0 and 0 from 1 us on;
*   mr = (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)     is 0 at time 0 and 1 from 1 us on.
*
* ---- upper (threshold) comparator ----
* output -> 1 when THRES > CTRL (2/3 Vcc). Drives the latch RESET input.
* Smooth step 2 mV wide (1 V wide at time 0).
bcomphi chi gnd v = 0.5*(1 + tanh(v(thres,ctrl)/(0.002 + 1.0*(time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0))))
*
* ---- lower (trigger) comparator ----
* output -> 1 when TRIG < 1/3 Vcc (node n13). Drives the latch SET input.
bcomplo clo gnd v = 0.5*(1 + tanh(v(n13,trig)/(0.002 + 1.0*(time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0))))
*
* ---- active-low RESET pin gate (datasheet threshold about 1 V) ----
* rok -> 1 when the pin is high (latch allowed to run), -> 0 when pulled low.
brok rok gnd v = 0.5*(1 + tanh((v(reset,gnd) - 1)/0.05))
*
* ---- RS latch with active-low RESET pin override ----
* State node 'q' is algebraic: the voltage source below forces
*   q = run * ( clo + (1-clo)*mr*hold(q) ),   run = (1-chi)*rok,
*   hold(q) = 1 when q > 0.5, else 0.
* run is 0 whenever the upper comparator or the RESET pin resets the latch
* (RESET is dominant, per the datasheet) and clo = 1 sets it. The self-reference
* through hold(q) is the latch memory, with two branches:
*   set branch    q = run      (hold = 1), valid while run > 0.5
*   reset branch  q = run*clo  (hold = 0), valid while run*clo < 0.5
* so the latch resets when the upper comparator passes its midpoint (THRES =
* CTRL) or RESET falls through 1 V, and sets when the lower comparator passes
* its midpoint (TRIG = Vcc/3). The memory term is off at time 0 (mr = 0), so the
* operating point is the smooth function q = run*clo: output low and discharge
* on whenever neither comparator is active, with no memory to choose between two
* states. There is deliberately no capacitor or lag on q (see "Solver step"
* above): the real part's propagation delay (about 100 ns) is far below the
* step circsim normally takes.
bq q gnd v = v(rok,gnd)*(1 - v(chi,gnd))*( v(clo,gnd) + (1 - v(clo,gnd))*(time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0) )
* Read the latch state for the output. From 1 us on this is the same hard
* decision as the memory, so the output changes only when q jumps between
* branches. A readout that moved along a branch (q runs from 1 down to 0.5 on
* the set branch as THRES approaches CTRL) would let the discharge switch and
* THRES settle into an analog equilibrium at the threshold. At time 0 it is a
* smooth step of slope 8 per volt.
bqd qd gnd v = (time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0)*0.5*(1 + tanh(8*(v(q,gnd) - 0.5))) + (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0)
*
* ---- output buffer (pin 3) ----
* OUT is HIGH (Vcc - 0.5) when the latch is SET, LOW (0.1 V) when reset,
* through a small output resistance; RESET low forces the output to 0 V. The
* buffer is referenced to the gnd pin, so current the load pushes into OUT
* leaves through gnd on its own. A 0 V sense source in series with the output
* resistance measures the output current, and a controlled source moves the
* SOURCED current from vcc to gnd so the supply pin carries the load (faded
* out below about 2 V so a floating rail carries nothing).
bout obuf gnd v = v(rok,gnd)*( 0.1 + (v(vcc,gnd) - 0.6)*v(qd,gnd) )
rout obuf osns 10
vsns osns out 0
bsrc vcc gnd i = 0.5*(1 + tanh((v(vcc,gnd) - 1)/0.25))*0.5*( i(vsns) + sqrt(i(vsns)*i(vsns) + 1e-12) )
*
* ---- discharge transistor (pin 7, open collector to GND) ----
* The discharge transistor is ON (DISCH pulled to GND through 15 ohm) when the
* output is LOW (latch reset) and OFF (1 Gohm) when the output is HIGH. RESET
* low forces it ON. Modeled as a voltage-controlled conductance from DISCH to
* GND; the current it sinks leaves through the gnd pin. The state readout inside
* it is the same as qd from 1 us on, and softer than qd at time 0 (3 per volt),
* because the loop through THRES is what the operating point has to solve.
bdisch disch gnd i = v(disch,gnd)*( (1 - ((time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0)*0.5*(1 + tanh(3*(v(q,gnd) - 0.5))) + (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0))*v(rok,gnd))/15 + (((time < 1e-6 ? 1 - time/1e-6 : 0)*0.5*(1 + tanh(3*(v(q,gnd) - 0.5))) + (time < 1e-6 ? time/1e-6 : 1)*(v(q,gnd) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0))*v(rok,gnd))/1e9 )
.ends NE555

models.definition:

.ends TL431
